  props: {},

    this.props = mergeObjects(this.defaultProps, props)

      window.addEventListener("resize", this.setAdaptiveAndRender.bind(this))

      this.render()

  setAdaptiveAndRender: function () {
    const adaptive = {

      phone: window.innerWidth <= 700

    this.props.adaptive = adaptive

    this.render()
  },

  render: function () {
    let adaptiveClass = ""
    const statusCode = this.props.statusCode || "503"

    if (this.props.adaptive.tablet) adaptiveClass += " CEP__tablet"
    if (this.props.adaptive.phone) adaptiveClass += " CEP__phone"
    if (!this.props.adaptive.tablet && !this.props.adaptive.phone) adaptiveClass += " CEP__desktop"

    this.html = `<section id='carfax-error-pages' class='font-black${adaptiveClass}' ${this.props["data-testid"] ? `data-testid="${this.props["data-testid"]}"` : ""}>
    <div class="CEP_container">  
      <div class='CEP_back'>
        <button class='CEP_back_button' onclick='window.history.back()'>
          <svg class='CEP_svg' viewBox='0 0 24 24' aria-hidden='true'>
            <path d='M20 11v2H8l5.5 5.5-1.42 1.42L4.16 12l7.92-7.92L13.5 5.5 8 11z' />
          </svg>
          ${this.copy.backToPrevious[this.props.i18n]}
        </button>
      </div>
      <div class='CEP_content'>
        <div class='CEP_content_left'>
          <div class='CEP_content_left_div'>${statusCode} Error</div>
          <h1 class='CEP_content_left_h1'>${this.copy[statusCode].title[this.props.i18n]}</h1>
          <p class='CEP_content_left_p'>${this.copy[statusCode].subtitle[this.props.i18n]}</p>
        </div>
        <div class='CEP_content_right'>
          ${this.renderPicture()}
          <ul class='CEP_links'>
            ${this.renderActionByType(this.actions.CCL)}
            ${this.renderActionByType(this.actions.MYC)}
            ${this.renderActionByType(this.actions.VHR)}
          </ul>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
</section>`

    if (this.props.target) {
      document.getElementById(this.props.target).innerHTML = this.html
    } else {
      const event = new Event("cfxErrorPagesRender", {
        bubbles: true,
        cancelable: true
      })

      document.dispatchEvent(event)
    }
  },

  renderPicture: function () {
    const imgUrl = `https://images.carfax.com/image/${this.images[this.props.adaptive.phone ? "lookingDown" : "presenting"]}`
    const imgSize = this.props.adaptive.phone ? "132" : "234"
    const imgAspectRatio = this.props.adaptive.phone ? "1.41" : "0.87"
    const imgAlt = this.props.adaptive.phone
      ? "Car Fox leaning over and looking down at something."
      : "Car Fox smiling, presenting to his right."

    return `<picture class="CEP_picture">
        <source
          type='image/avif'
          srcSet='${imgUrl}?format=avif&width=${imgSize}'
        />
        <source
          type='image/webp'
          srcSet='${imgUrl}?format=webp&width=${imgSize}'
        />
        <img
          alt='${imgAlt}'
          aria-hidden='true'
          class="CEP_img"
          loading='lazy'
          referrerPolicy='no-referrer-when-downgrade'
          src='${imgUrl}?width=${imgSize}'
          style='aspect-ratio: ${imgAspectRatio};'
          width='${imgSize}'
        />
      </picture>`
  },

  renderActionByType: function ({ svgPath, href, text }) {
    return `<li class='CEP_links_li'>
  <a href='https://www.carfax.${this.props.isCanada ? "ca" : "com"}${href}' class='CEP_links_a'>
    <span class='CEP_links_span'>
      <svg class='CEP_svg' viewBox='0 0 24 24' aria-hidden='true'>
        ${svgPath.map(path => `<path d='${path.d}' fill-rule='${path.fillRule || "evenodd"}' />`).join("")}

    <svg class='CEP_svg' viewBox='0 0 24 24' aria-hidden='true'>
      <path d='M8.59 16.59 13.17 12 8.59 7.41 10 6l6 6-6 6z' />
    </svg> 
  </a>
</li>`
  }
}

    i18n: "en",

    statusCode: undefined,

  props: {},

  initialize: function (props) {
    this.props = mergeObjects(this.defaultProps, props)

    if (props.adaptive !== undefined) {
      window.removeEventListener("resize", this.setAdaptiveAndRender)
      window.addEventListener("resize", this.setAdaptiveAndRender.bind(this))
      this.setAdaptiveAndRender()
    } else {
      this.render()
    }
  },

  setAdaptiveAndRender: function () {
    const adaptive = {
      tablet: window.innerWidth <= 1024,
      phone: window.innerWidth <= 700
    }

    this.props.adaptive = adaptive

    this.render()
  },

  render: function () {
    let adaptiveClass = ""
    const statusCode = this.props.statusCode || "503"

    if (this.props.adaptive.tablet) adaptiveClass += " CEP__tablet"
    if (this.props.adaptive.phone) adaptiveClass += " CEP__phone"
    if (!this.props.adaptive.tablet && !this.props.adaptive.phone) adaptiveClass += " CEP__desktop"

    this.html = `<section id='carfax-error-pages' class='font-black${adaptiveClass}' ${this.props["data-testid"] ? `data-testid="${this.props["data-testid"]}"` : ""}>
    <div class="CEP_container">  
      <div class='CEP_back'>
        <button class='CEP_back_button' onclick='window.history.back()'>
          <svg class='CEP_svg' viewBox='0 0 24 24' aria-hidden='true'>
            <path d='M20 11v2H8l5.5 5.5-1.42 1.42L4.16 12l7.92-7.92L13.5 5.5 8 11z' />
          </svg>
          ${this.copy.backToPrevious[this.props.i18n]}
        </button>
      </div>
      <div class='CEP_content'>
        <div class='CEP_content_left'>
          <div class='CEP_content_left_div'>${statusCode} Error</div>
          <h1 class='CEP_content_left_h1'>${this.copy[statusCode].title[this.props.i18n]}</h1>
          <p class='CEP_content_left_p'>${this.copy[statusCode].subtitle[this.props.i18n]}</p>
        </div>
        <div class='CEP_content_right'>
          ${this.renderPicture()}
          <ul class='CEP_links'>
            ${this.renderActionByType(this.actions.CCL)}
            ${this.renderActionByType(this.actions.MYC)}
            ${this.renderActionByType(this.actions.VHR)}
          </ul>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
</section>`

    if (this.props.target) {
      document.getElementById(this.props.target).innerHTML = this.html
    } else {
      const event = new Event("cfxErrorPagesRender", {
        bubbles: true,
        cancelable: true
      })

      document.dispatchEvent(event)
    }
  },

  renderPicture: function () {
    const imgUrl = `https://images.carfax.com/image/${this.images[this.props.adaptive.phone ? "lookingDown" : "presenting"]}`
    const imgSize = this.props.adaptive.phone ? "132" : "234"
    const imgAspectRatio = this.props.adaptive.phone ? "1.41" : "0.87"
    const imgAlt = this.props.adaptive.phone
      ? "Car Fox leaning over and looking down at something."
      : "Car Fox smiling, presenting to his right."

    return `<picture class="CEP_picture">
        <source
          type='image/avif'
          srcSet='${imgUrl}?format=avif&width=${imgSize}'
        />
        <source
          type='image/webp'
          srcSet='${imgUrl}?format=webp&width=${imgSize}'
        />
        <img
          alt='${imgAlt}'
          aria-hidden='true'
          class="CEP_img"
          loading='lazy'
          referrerPolicy='no-referrer-when-downgrade'
          src='${imgUrl}?width=${imgSize}'
          style='aspect-ratio: ${imgAspectRatio};'
          width='${imgSize}'
        />
      </picture>`
  },

  renderActionByType: function ({ svgPath, href, text }) {
    return `<li class='CEP_links_li'>
  <a href='https://www.carfax.${this.props.isCanada ? "ca" : "com"}${href}' class='CEP_links_a'>
    <span class='CEP_links_span'>
      <svg class='CEP_svg' viewBox='0 0 24 24' aria-hidden='true'>
        ${svgPath.map(path => `<path d='${path.d}' fill-rule='${path.fillRule || "evenodd"}' />`).join("")}
      </svg> 
      ${text[this.props.i18n]}
    </span>
    <svg class='CEP_svg' viewBox='0 0 24 24' aria-hidden='true'>
      <path d='M8.59 16.59 13.17 12 8.59 7.41 10 6l6 6-6 6z' />
    </svg> 
  </a>
</li>`
  }
}

  },

  props: {},

  initialize: function (props) {
    this.props = mergeObjects(this.defaultProps, props)

    if (props.adaptive !== undefined) {
      window.removeEventListener("resize", this.setAdaptiveAndRender)
      window.addEventListener("resize", this.setAdaptiveAndRender.bind(this))
      this.setAdaptiveAndRender()
    } else {
      this.render()
    }
  },

  setAdaptiveAndRender: function () {
    const adaptive = {
      tablet: window.innerWidth <= 1024,
      phone: window.innerWidth <= 700
    }

    this.props.adaptive = adaptive

    this.render()
  },

  render: function () {
    let adaptiveClass = ""
    const statusCode = this.props.statusCode || "503"

    if (this.props.adaptive.tablet) adaptiveClass += " CEP__tablet"
    if (this.props.adaptive.phone) adaptiveClass += " CEP__phone"
    if (!this.props.adaptive.tablet && !this.props.adaptive.phone) adaptiveClass += " CEP__desktop"

    this.html = `<section id='carfax-error-pages' class='font-black${adaptiveClass}' ${this.props["data-testid"] ? `data-testid="${this.props["data-testid"]}"` : ""}>
    <div class="CEP_container">  
      <div class='CEP_back'>
        <button class='CEP_back_button' onclick='window.history.back()'>
          <svg class='CEP_svg' viewBox='0 0 24 24' aria-hidden='true'>
            <path d='M20 11v2H8l5.5 5.5-1.42 1.42L4.16 12l7.92-7.92L13.5 5.5 8 11z' />
          </svg>
          ${this.copy.backToPrevious[this.props.i18n]}
        </button>
      </div>
      <div class='CEP_content'>
        <div class='CEP_content_left'>
          <div class='CEP_content_left_div'>${statusCode} Error</div>
          <h1 class='CEP_content_left_h1'>${this.copy[statusCode].title[this.props.i18n]}</h1>
          <p class='CEP_content_left_p'>${this.copy[statusCode].subtitle[this.props.i18n]}</p>
        </div>
        <div class='CEP_content_right'>
          ${this.renderPicture()}
          <ul class='CEP_links'>
            ${this.renderActionByType(this.actions.CCL)}
            ${this.renderActionByType(this.actions.MYC)}
            ${this.renderActionByType(this.actions.VHR)}
          </ul>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
</section>`

    if (this.props.target) {
      document.getElementById(this.props.target).innerHTML = this.html
    } else {
      const event = new Event("cfxErrorPagesRender", {
        bubbles: true,
        cancelable: true
      })

      document.dispatchEvent(event)
    }
  },

  renderPicture: function () {
    const imgUrl = `https://images.carfax.com/image/${this.images[this.props.adaptive.phone ? "lookingDown" : "presenting"]}`
    const imgSize = this.props.adaptive.phone ? "132" : "234"
    const imgAspectRatio = this.props.adaptive.phone ? "1.41" : "0.87"
    const imgAlt = this.props.adaptive.phone
      ? "Car Fox leaning over and looking down at something."
      : "Car Fox smiling, presenting to his right."

    return `<picture class="CEP_picture">
        <source
          type='image/avif'
          srcSet='${imgUrl}?format=avif&width=${imgSize}'
        />
        <source
          type='image/webp'
          srcSet='${imgUrl}?format=webp&width=${imgSize}'
        />
        <img
          alt='${imgAlt}'
          aria-hidden='true'
          class="CEP_img"
          loading='lazy'
          referrerPolicy='no-referrer-when-downgrade'
          src='${imgUrl}?width=${imgSize}'
          style='aspect-ratio: ${imgAspectRatio};'
          width='${imgSize}'
        />
      </picture>`
  },

  renderActionByType: function ({ svgPath, href, text }) {
    return `<li class='CEP_links_li'>
  <a href='https://www.carfax.${this.props.isCanada ? "ca" : "com"}${href}' class='CEP_links_a'>
    <span class='CEP_links_span'>
      <svg class='CEP_svg' viewBox='0 0 24 24' aria-hidden='true'>
        ${svgPath.map(path => `<path d='${path.d}' fill-rule='${path.fillRule || "evenodd"}' />`).join("")}
      </svg> 
      ${text[this.props.i18n]}
    </span>
    <svg class='CEP_svg' viewBox='0 0 24 24' aria-hidden='true'>
      <path d='M8.59 16.59 13.17 12 8.59 7.41 10 6l6 6-6 6z' />
    </svg> 
  </a>
</li>`
  }
}
